Matt S: Quick sync — SeCureNet signed the POC. They require BYO customer-managed keys in an HSM, 30-day rotation window, and an offline escrow option. Need: a short ops timeline, any pricing delta for BYO-HSM + dedicated proxy, and what we need for the security questionnaire.
Julia L: Nice! High level steps: 1) network allowlist + peering docs, 2) KMS handshake + attestation, 3) HSM proxy deploy + smoke tests, 4) run key ceremony for escrow.
Matt S: Can you ballpark the pricing delta? Sales wants to confirm before legal signs SOW.
Julia L: Ballpark: BYO-HSM support + dedicated proxy is usually a one-time setup fee (~$12k) + monthly reserved for dedicated throughput (~$1.2k/mo). If they want HSM attestation/onsite facilitation for ceremony add a professional services day rate. I can draft a formal line item.
Samir R: Security Qs we always see: Do you support HSM attestation? Dual-custodian key escrow? Key use audit logs and retention? Exportability policy? We need to prefill those for their questionnaire.
Matt S: They specifically asked "Can keys be rotated automatically and can we retain previous ciphertext versions for rollback?"
Julia L: Yes — our platform supports scheduled rotation (we can push rotation to the BYOK HSM via the proxy). We keep key version metadata and can preserve ciphertext, but we don't store customer plaintext keys. We'll need the customer's consent for retention windows.
Priya N: On ops timeline: once we have network + IAM allowlist + a test key (wrapped) from their HSM vendor, we can spin up the proxy in their VPC in ~3 business days, then run the smoke tests (another 1 day). Key ceremony/escrow depends on customer's schedule — can be onsite or remote with attestation artifacts, plan on 2–5 business days.
Matt S: What logs/traces do we provide for compliance? They asked for per-request key id, operation, and timestamp.
Samir R: We surface key_id, operation (encrypt/decrypt), request ts, requestor identity, and the HSM attestation token (when available). We retain logs per the customer's retention policy; longer retention is an add-on. Note: audit logs don't include raw key material.
Julia L: For the security questionnaire I'll add these bullets and attach a sample attestation statement. Also need confirmation of which HSM vendor (AWS CloudHSM, Thales Luna, etc.) — different vendors change the proxy config and estimations.
Matt S: They've said AWS CloudHSM first pass but might evaluate Luna. I'll ask them to confirm and to generate a wrapped test key for us to validate.
ops-bot: New POC workspace created: workspace/securenet-poc-1769212345 (assigned to @Julia L).
Matt S: Action items: Julia to send pricing line items + sample SOW language; Samir to draft answers for the questionnaire sections on attestation/escrow/logging; Priya to prepare an ops runbook checklist (network, IAM, smoke tests). I'll follow up with customer this afternoon and ask them to produce the wrapped test key and preferred HSM vendor.
Julia L: Will do. I'll put the pricing SOW draft in the POC workspace and ping here once ready. :thumbsup:
Samir R: I'll seed the questionnaire answers and add notes about legal caveats on escrow — some customers need split-escrow with two custodians.
Matt S: Great — thanks team. If we see they want <24h rotation or multi-region mirrored HSMs, flag early — that changes infra and cost.
Priya N: Noted. Also running reminder: ensure our proxy image is on their ECR/registry or we run it in their subnet for air-gapped setups.
Matt S: Perfect. Closing for now, will report back after their confirmation.
